lines.text: Job lived in the land of Uz, was blameless and upright, and had seven sons and three daughters.
When the feasting was over, Job rose early and offered burnt offerings for his children.
Satan came with the sons of God before the LORD and said he had come from Egypt.
The LORD put everything Job had in Satan's hands, and the Sabeans took the camels.
A mighty wind from the desert collapsed the house, and Job worshiped and did not charge God with wrongdoing.
